2607.20589.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Persona Simulation in Opinion Prediction with GPT-4.1
2607.20589.paper_summary: Persona simulation involves utilizing large language models (LLMs) to anticipate human choices or interactions based on specific characteristic information. To further understand current limitations and future directions, we tested persona simulation in opinion prediction with GPT-4.1 (knowledge cutoff by June 2024). Using personas from nine U.S. states provided by Columbia University's Personas dataset, GPT-4.1 accurately predicted 2024 election outcomes in eight out of the nine states, only failing in one of the swing states. We then focused on opinions related to medicine and healthcare. With the American Trends Panel Wave 123 dataset from Pew Research Center, GPT-4.1 was able to anticipate beliefs about childhood vaccines with an accuracy of up to 0.94. Furthermore, we applied GPT-4.1 to generate conversations among personas and observed that the simulated dialogues and opinions adhered well to personas' personalities and backgrounds, albeit lacking natural human-like flow. Persona simulation proves to be a promising application of artificial intelligence as long as biases are addressed. In the near future, it will be beneficial to apply it to opinion analysis and reaction prediction in diverse fields ranging from public health to lawmaking to economics.
2607.20589.paper_summary_zh: 人格模擬涉及利用大型語言模型 (LLMs) 根據特定特徵信息預測人類選擇或互動。為了進一步了解當前的限制和未來的方向，我們在意見預測中測試了 GPT-4.1（知識截止於 2024 年 6 月）。使用哥倫比亞大學的 Personas 數據集提供的來自九個美國州的角色，GPT-4.1 在九個州中準確預測了 2024 年的選舉結果，其中八個州的預測正確，只有一個搖擺州的預測失敗。然後，我們專注於與醫療和健康護理相關的意見。利用皮尤研究中心的美國趨勢小組第 123 波數據集，GPT-4.1 能夠以高達 0.94 的準確率預測對兒童疫苗的信念。此外，我們還應用 GPT-4.1 生成角色之間的對話，觀察到模擬的對話和意見很好地遵循了角色的個性和背景，儘管缺乏自然的人類流暢性。人格模擬證明是人工智能的一個有前途的應用，只要能夠解決偏見。在不久的將來，將其應用於各個領域的意見分析和反應預測，從公共衛生到立法再到經濟學，將是有益的。
2607.20589.author: Sarah Y. Li et.al.
